notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo + Inventory Items
notes.content: [h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2][p]We would like to inform you that we are taking part in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], this means that you can try out the demo version of our game during the whole festival and any time after, we will not remove it after the festival is over so all items you acquire will be safe! [/p][p][/p][h2]Features available in the demo[/h2][h3]Items for inventory[/h3][p]While playing the demo version of our game you will receive [b]one item every 3 hours[/b] and [b]one rare item every day[/b]. Items [b]can be exchanged and sold[/b] on Steam Marketplace[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588291/b787c7763ab55209f5b3a26cea93ac83b404fbb4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Game Mode[/h3][p]The demo contains [b]waves mode[/b] - one of two modes that will be on the game's release, in this mode you will have to [b]survive 20 waves[/b] consisting of lizards and Italian brainrot animals. [/p][p][/p][h3]4 playable characters with the following weapons: [/h3][list][*][p]Shotgun[/p][/*][*][p]Assault Rifle[/p][/*][*][p]Two golden machine guns[/p][/*][*][p]RPG[/p][/*][/list][p]Choose one to start and pick up two more as you progress through the waves. [/p][p][/p][h3]Weapon Customization:[/h3][p]Each weapon can be customized by changing its parts, change sights, magazines, stocks and more to tailor the weapon to your play style[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588291/d016f1e3710f7a719b8c1190058069fc42ca2c2f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Character Customization: [/h3][p]Each character can wear up to 5 clothing items that you will receive as rewards for completing certain waves, each clothing item can give up to 6 bonus stats depending on rarity, bonus stats have random numerical values that depend on the tier (path of exile - like system)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588291/2f70f87ec46aef2162163cb1ca28d11f300e1d15.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Communication[/h3][p]We look forward to your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]By mail gosdevproduction@gmail.com[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3674790/discussions/"]In Steam discussions[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Or in [url="https://discord.gg/xWa7u7dTDk"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Also subscribe to our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/39326232/"]curator[/url][/p][p]And our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev"]group[/url][/p][p]To make sure you don't miss new releases![/p]
